# Montgomery College Pressbooks Network

> A curated collection of open educational resources (OER) and interactive textbooks for mathematics, statistics, and higher education learning.

Montgomery College Pressbooks Network hosts peer-reviewed open textbooks and educational materials developed by faculty and instructors. The platform emphasizes accessibility, creative commons licensing, and interactive learning tools for statistics and mathematics education.

## Key Topics

- Open Educational Resources (OER)
- Statistics Calculators
- Creative Commons Licensing
- StatKey
- Probability and Statistics
- Data Visualization
- Linear Regression
- TI-83/TI-84 Calculators
- Desmos
- Interactive Textbooks
- Higher Education
- Digital Accessibility
- H5P Activities
- Montgomery College
- Open Textbook Publishing

## Catalog & Collections

- [Catalog – Montgomery College Pressbooks Network](https://pressbooks.montgomerycollege.edu/catalog): Montgomery College Pressbooks catalog of open educational resources and OER content

## Statistics Calculators Textbook

- [Statistics Calculators – Simple Book Publishing](https://pressbooks.montgomerycollege.edu/statcalcs/): Statistics Calculators open textbook by Ram Subedi for probability and math tools
- [Introduction – Statistics Calculators](https://pressbooks.montgomerycollege.edu/statcalcs/front-matter/introduction/): Introduction guide to statistics calculators including SUBEDI, Desmos, and StatKey

## Data Visualization & Graphing

- [Graphs: Boxplots, Dotplots, Histograms, Scatterplots – Statistics Calculators](https://pressbooks.montgomerycollege.edu/statcalcs/chapter/graphs-boxplots-dotplots-histograms-scatterplots/): Tutorial on data visualization graphs using StatKey, Desmos, and TI calculators

## Probability & Statistical Analysis

- [Probability Distribution Calculators – Statistics Calculators](https://pressbooks.montgomerycollege.edu/statcalcs/chapter/probability-distribution-calculators/): Guide to probability distribution calculators for normal and t-distributions
- [Linear Regression and Correlation – Statistics Calculators](https://pressbooks.montgomerycollege.edu/statcalcs/chapter/linear-regression-and-correlation/): Tutorial on linear regression and correlation analysis using Desmos and StatKey
